summary: Strengthen HR service ownership, workforce planning and people reporting. Explore the five-day foundation course and its practical curriculum.
lede: HR leadership training helps HR professionals coordinate people services and explain workforce decisions. It is designed for HR officers, business partners and team leads who need to map service responsibilities, manage employee case triage, and turn workforce information into plans and leadership reports using practical HR tools and consistent processes.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who coordinate HR services, advise line leaders or contribute workforce information to management decisions.
modules: CIPD Profession Map for HR Leadership
HRIS Metrics and AI Screening Governance
ISO 30414 Reporting and HR Action Plan
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace teams or HR processes is useful. No specialist HR qualification or coding ability is required.
